summary: The recorded base already contains the demonstrated lifetime fix: grouped allocator frees clone tensor views when ownership transfers to the allocator. A new page-size-64 regression uses the real RadixCache and PagedTokenToKVPoolAllocator and reproduces the C++ radix ordering (insert, defer duplicate request-table view, rebind row, end free group). Disabling the ownership clone deterministically frees the radix-owned page instead of the duplicate request page; the checked-in implementation preserves the radix page. No additional production-code change was needed.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before ownership regression: the original request page was absent from the free list because the deferred view had been rebound to the radix page. Raw output: reports/j-67378311d90b/raw/paged_ownership_before.log

Passing-after ownership census for both token and page allocators: duplicate request storage is freed, canonical radix storage remains owned, request-table and radix lookup both retain canonical indices. Raw output: reports/j-67378311d90b/raw/ownership_regressions.log

gpu_execution.evidence: reports/j-67378311d90b/raw/gpu_paged_ownership.log records AMD Instinct MI350X, gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-, correct page ownership, and max_abs_error 0.0.

remaining_limitations: The reported RadixArk/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-NVFP4 model, QSA KDA kernel, EAGLE speculative decode, NVFP4 KV cache, SM121/DGX Spark hardware, and token 248319 serving failure were not available and were not reproduced.

The new regression validates the concrete allocator/view lifetime defect and page-size-64 radix ownership ordering, not end-to-end model logits or the report's claim that this is the only possible cause of the observed impossible-token loop.

The Python RadixCache free_segment path materializes page representatives and did not alias under the temporary pre-fix semantics; the failing ordering applies to direct deferred request-table views such as the C++ radix-style path modeled by the regression.
No native source changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.
